values.note: $14 a night for a primitive site, every night in the calendar read. Electric $43 Sunday-Wednesday nights, Thursday-Saturday +$7. No out-of-state camping rate (the park entrance fee differs by plates). Indiana's rate page gives only statewide ranges; these are the booking site's prices for April 2027 nights, read 2026-10-31.

summary: Confirmed $14 primitive base (fits 23 ft), electric $43, +$7 Thu-Sat on electric, lakefront note left. Added 50A, 500 sites, 65-ft max, dump, RA link.
flags: BASE: $14 stands. RA's 'Primitive' sites read are paved back-ins with Max Vehicle Length 25-52 (most 40), so a 23-ft motorhome fits. No hookups. Primitive showed no Thu-Sat premium in the calendar read; the weekend surcharge is the electric sites'.
